Intro.title: About
Intro.body: 5 years owning SaaS platforms end-to-end — from design systems and payment-critical registration flows to data grids built for 500K+ participants. Leadership here has never meant a title; it meant being the person others rely on when the system is on fire.

uni-donate.title: uni-donate
uni-donate.description: Blockchain donation platform. Learned Svelte from zero in one week to ship it — the win earned an invitation to the United Nations office in Qatar.

privateStorybook.title: Private Storybook
privateStorybook.description: A dark-first design system generated from TypeScript straight into Figma: components, variants, icons, tokens and page templates from one source of truth.

orbit.title: Orbit
orbit.description: A public map with self-intro access: request access, introduce yourself, get approved, download the payload.

omm.title: Omm
omm.description: Internal dashboard behind custom SSO — overview, CRUD over points, and reviewing the intro requests coming in from Orbit.

ai-tooling-security.title: AI Tooling Security
ai-tooling-security.description: Investigating AI-agent tooling and where the holes are — threat-modelling what happens when a compromised agent reaches docker.sock, and prototyping a proxy layer that filters agent output.

sporTechCompany.summary: Sports-event SaaS for 500K+ participants — dynamic registration, payments, and an embeddable B2B widget.
bullets: Took over after a failed €2M CRM delivery: rebuilt the platform and cut delivery cost from ~€38K/month to ~€12K/month while retaining key clients.
Shipped participant management and public registration end-to-end, then packaged the flow as an embeddable widget that landed a new B2B client.
After the backend lead left, wrote the tickets and component requirements and guided the rebuild of the API.

addTechCompany.summary: Media-planning SaaS with a virtualized reference grid and drag-and-drop workflows.
bullets: Owned code quality and architecture on the media-planning platform; turned the media-plan table into the product’s reference grid.
Stayed hands-on by choice: declined a management-track promotion to keep building.

Credibility.quote: "Huge thanks for this amazing contribution — we really appreciate that you invested time learning and aligning to onyx principles."
Credibility.awardTitle: 1st Place — South Africa Blockchain in Education Hackathon

BeyondCode.title: The part that explains the rest.

music.title: Music, 15 years
music.body: Recorder from age four — learned notes before letters — and trumpet from 11 to 19. Handel, Albinoni, Piazzolla; originals only. Music taught me precision: small details compound into masterpieces, or into bugs.

boxing.title: Boxing
boxing.body: A year and a half of it. Discipline, and staying calm when hit.

books.title: Books
books.body: Tom Sawyer, the Orthodox Bible, and on the reread list: Goethe's Faust, Dante, Gorky's Danko — the man who carried everything alone. Carrying everything solo was my biggest flaw; delegation is the fix.

pattern-matching.title: Pattern-matching
pattern-matching.body: Attentive by nature — I remember key facts and build cause-and-effect chains like a detective. It found the vulnerabilities; it also gets me called paranoid. Both are true costs of the same skill.

Links.title: A few doors worth opening.
Links.summary: The short list — work, words, and where to find me. Everything else can wait.
